description: US online marketplace selling products from independent makers and small brands — coffee, pantry goods, skincare, supplements and pet food — with an open partner program for creators and publishers.

evidence.summary: Loyaltie's own partner page (fetched in full) states 'there is no cap on what you can earn'. The program runs on Impact with tiers: Standard 5% (open, instant approval), Featured 10% (creators and publishers), and Founding (by invitation). Commission is paid on the whole basket, for new and returning customers.

name: Loyaltie

opportunity.audience_fit: Food, pantry, small-brand discovery and shop-small audiences.
risks: Open tier starts at 5%; the 10% Featured tier is selective
Marketplace is smaller and newer than major retailers, so catalog depth varies
opportunity.summary: Verified-uncapped Impact program with an instant-approval open tier at 5% and a 10% creator tier, paying on whole baskets from independent maker brands.

reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped earnings; 5% open tier rising to 10% for creators on whole-basket orders.
reasons.contact_access: Direct partnerships email published on the program page.
reasons.credibility: Smaller, newer marketplace; terms are stated plainly on the brand's own page.
reasons.niche_fit: Marketplace spans coffee, pantry, supplements and pet food from independent makers — broad food and wellness fit.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Standard tier is open with instant approval on Impact.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Dedicated partner page actively recruiting creators and publishers with a named creator tier.
